watches.name: Straum Expedition White Lume
watches.description: The Straum Expedition is the first watch in our Built For collection — built for Norwegian nature rather than inspired by it. Every element earns its place: a hardened Grade 5 titanium case whose broadened flank deflects impacts away from the crystal, a stepped bezel that lowers the case's highest plane, and an enlarged screw-down crown sized for cold or gloved hands. The White dial carries the idea to its end — a fully luminous foil surface that charges in daylight and glows through the night, black PVD indexes and hands drawn against it. Fluor Orange marks the date, the Expedition signature and the seconds tip, and a luminous circle on the seconds hand confirms the movement is running in complete darkness.

watches.name: Straum Expedition Titanium Gray
watches.description: The Straum Expedition is the first watch in our Built For collection — built for Norwegian nature rather than inspired by it. Every element earns its place: a hardened Grade 5 titanium case whose broadened flank deflects impacts away from the crystal, a stepped bezel that lowers the case's highest plane, and an enlarged screw-down crown sized for cold or gloved hands. The Titanium Gray dial is bare, bead-blasted titanium, its numerals and indices cast in solid white Super-LumiNova beneath black PVD hands. Fluor Orange marks the date, the Expedition signature and the seconds tip, and a luminous circle on the seconds hand confirms the movement is running in complete darkness.

watches.name: Straum Expedition Midnight Blue
watches.description: The Straum Expedition is the first watch in our Built For collection — built for Norwegian nature rather than inspired by it. Every element earns its place: a hardened Grade 5 titanium case whose broadened flank deflects impacts away from the crystal, a stepped bezel that lowers the case's highest plane, and an enlarged screw-down crown sized for cold or gloved hands. The Midnight Blue Launch Edition is limited to 200 pieces. Its dial holds the colour of the sky after the sun has gone, set with solid cast lume markers and nickel-plated hour and minute hands over a black PVD seconds hand. Fluor Orange marks the date, the Expedition signature and the seconds tip, and a luminous circle on the seconds hand confirms the movement is running in complete darkness.

watches.name: Frozen Metal Titanium
watches.description: The Frozen Metal Titanium captures the moment ice takes hold. Its all-new dial texture mirrors the way frost forms at the edges and creeps inward, a galvanic frosting treatment ringing the perimeter in granular white before receding to bare, silvered metal, for a reverse fumé that appears frozen from the outside in. The handset and applied indices are finished in cool "Frostbite Blue" PVD, set against a 38.7mm Grade 5 titanium case built for the cold.

watches.name: Rastarkalv
watches.description: A watch for the ages – raw Norwegian nature and premium Swiss Made quality combined. The RASTARKALV dial is 3,300 years old, made from a root extracted from the swamp at Rastarkalv, Frei. Refined into a limited edition of 47 uniquely numbered dials set inside our Straum 316L Damascus Steel watch case, protected by the double-domed Sapphire glass with internal AR coatings, surrounded by the stainless steel sunburst and polished bezel. The Sapphire back reveals the Swiss-made Sellita SW-200-1 movement. Diamond-cut hands and indexes with Superluminova BGW9. Complete with a vegetable-tanned full grain leather strap with a custom Straum buckle.

watches.name: Straum × TRTS Jan Mayen Titanium Stormy Seas
watches.description: Straum × TRTS Jan Mayen Titanium Stormy Seas is a special edition born from surviving a Force 9 gale. The dial captures the chaotic, violent waves of the ominous gray blue sea, sharply contrasted by the life-saving visibility of the Fluor Orange seconds hand.

watches.name: Straum × Time+Tide Jan Mayen Titanium
watches.description: The The Straum x Time+Tide Jan Mayen Titanium Special Edition captures the golden moss hue signaling survival against Arctic light and lack of moisture.

watches.name: Jan Mayen Glacier White
watches.description: Jan Mayen Glacier White manifests the windswept glacier surface of the Beerenberg volcano. The dial's jagged ridges mirror the rugged contours of ice sculpted by relentless blizzards. Delicate vertical stripes come alive under specific lighting, reminiscent of the wind sweeping across the surface, leaving freshly fallen snow in its wake, clinging to every available surface.

watches.name: Jan Mayen Moss Green
watches.description: Jan Mayen Moss Green captures the resilient mosses of Jan Mayen, draping the inhospitable landscape in a thick, gentle green carpet. The radial texture captures the faceted and jagged Arctic Moss, as it takes on the shape of the underlying landscape.

watches.name: Jan Mayen Arctic Blue
watches.description: Jan Mayen Arctic Blue captures the vast Arctic Ocean enveloping Jan Mayen with its icy currents and ferocious power. The intricate radial texture manifests the crashing waves constantly battering the island's coastline.

watches.name: Jan Mayen Black Sand
watches.description: Jan Mayen Black Sand unveils the battered coastline of Jan Mayen, with its foreboding beaches made of black volcanic sand. The dial's jagged ridges capture the underwater landscape of miniature dunes, shaped by the perpetual motion of water. Delicate vertical stripes spring to life under specific lighting conditions, showcasing nature's boundless creativity crafted with only two elements––sand and water.

watches.name: Jan Mayen Basalt Radiant Mist
watches.description: The Jan Mayen Basalt Radiant Mist is a Limited Edition watch, crafted from basalt rock collected during a two-week expedition to the remote volcanic island of Jan Mayen. Each dial, formed from solidified lava and gas pockets, showcases one-of-a-kind natural patterns. The ultra-thin basalt wafers are precisely cut, stabilized, and polished, then layered over a fully lumed base plate with a fumé treatment in a sandwich dial construction, producing a gradient glow that emanates subtly from the center outward, while retaining legibility.
